title: Additional-Day Rate by Booking Length, Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Tariff note — the additional-day rate on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.** The additional-day rate depends on the booking, the booked days being the calendar days from the scheduled pickup date to the scheduled return date (dates only, the times left aside):

- a contract booked for **3** or more days is charged, for each additional day, the lower of the first-day rental fee posted on its actual pickup date and the class base rate;
- a contract booked for two days is charged, for each additional day, the first-day rental fee posted on its actual pickup date, as posted;
- any other contract is charged the class base rate for each additional day.

The first-day rental fee posted on the actual pickup date is the base rental fee standing on the contract with that date as its service date.

## Branch table

| Booked days | Rate for each additional day |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | Class base rate |
| 2 | First-day rental fee posted on the actual pickup date, as posted |
| 3 or more | Lower of that first-day rental fee and the class base rate |

## Cases (hypothetical Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck contracts; class base rate 29.95)

| First-day rental fee posted on the actual pickup date | Booked days | Rate for each additional day |
|---|---|---|
| 32.95 | 2 | 32.95 |
| 32.95 | 3 | 29.95 — the lower of 32.95 and 29.95 |
| 26.96 | 3 | 26.96 — the lower of 26.96 and 29.95 |
| 26.96 | 2 | 26.96 |
| 26.96 | 1 | 29.95 |
